facts.business: Yash Innoventures Limited (formerly Redex Protech Limited) is an Indian listed company that recorded revenue from operations of Rs 138 lakhs in FY 2025-26 and holds an office building classified as investment property.

auditor.name: Shah and Shah Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: (1) Scheme of Amalgamation of Yash Shelters Limited sanctioned by NCLT order dated March 25, 2025 with restated comparatives; (2) Vacancy in Company Secretary office since October 31, 2025 leading to non-compliance with Section 203 of Companies Act, 2013 and Regulation 6 of SEBI LODR; (3) Investment property fair value not disclosed as required by Ind AS 40; (4) Managerial remuneration paid in inadequate profits situation without shareholder approval as at financial statement date.

key_risks: Non-compliance due to vacancy in Company Secretary/Compliance Officer role since October 31, 2025 with potential penalties
Managerial remuneration paid without required shareholder approval in inadequate profits scenario
Investment property fair value disclosure non-compliance with Ind AS 40
Scheme of Amalgamation restatement impacts on comparative financials
